subject: history
title: Weimar Republic Hyperinflation (1923)
summary: Severe economic collapse in post-WWI Germany caused by massive printing of fiat money to pay war reparations and Ruhr strike wages.
canonical_facts: Post-WWI Treaty of Versailles imposed heavy financial reparations on Germany.
Excessive currency printing destroyed purchasing power and wiped out middle-class savings.
Paved political ground for extremist movements and economic restructuring under the Dawes Plan.
